page: Microsoft Azure E8ads_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor running on the x86_64 architecture. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with multithreading enabled, operating at a clock speed of 4.5 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Local storage is bundled, consisting of a 472 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance is capable of utilizing Premium Storage.

Performance benchmarks indicate top-tier single-core CPU performance, with stress-ng single-core tests and single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression scoring in the top 10%. Multi-core CPU performance, multi-threaded decompression, and memory bandwidth tests fall within the average range. The system achieves an average of 14.2 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks and displays average database operation performance on PassMark.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the E8ads_v7 offers a high-density memory allocation relative to its compute footprint, making it a resource-efficient choice for memory-intensive workloads without paying for excess vCPUs. The inclusion of a local NVMe SSD provides fast temporary storage. This server is well-suited for relational databases, in-memory caching systems like Redis, data analytics, and memory-heavy enterprise applications.
